data.text:
Nestled in the heart of DAMAC Hills 2, Amazonia by DAMAC Properties is a premium gated sub-community that offers an unparalleled lifestyle in Dubai. Located to the northwest of the development and close to Jebel Ali - Lehbab Road (E77), Amazonia provides residents with a serene environment complemented by world-class amenities. 

Whether you're seeking a family-friendly neighborhood or exploring investment opportunities in Amazonia by DAMAC Properties, this community stands out as a prime choice.

Amazonia by DAMAC - An Overview

Amazonia by DAMAC Properties is a distinguished residential sub-community in DAMAC Hills 2, offering a harmonious blend of nature and modernity. This gated enclave presents a variety of townhouses and villas designed to provide an upscale lifestyle with state-of-the-art amenities. Residents enjoy a serene, family-friendly atmosphere while benefiting from easy connectivity to major road networks, including Jebel Ali - Lehbab Road (E77).

Surrounded by lush landscapes, DAMAC Properties Amazonia offers an array of facilities catering to fitness, recreation, and relaxation. The community boasts access to unique attractions such as a floating cinema, a butterfly garden, a lazy river, and a petting farm, ensuring an engaging living experience for all age groups.

For investors, investment opportunities in Amazonia by DAMAC Properties are promising, with competitive property prices and high rental demand. The development’s strategic location and comprehensive amenities make it an attractive choice for both end-users and investors looking to capitalize on Dubai’s thriving real estate market.

Prime Location & Connectivity

Amazonia by DAMAC Properties enjoys a strategic location within DAMAC Hills 2, offering easy access to major roads like the E77, ensuring smooth connectivity to Dubai’s bustling city center. 

The development is surrounded by retail outlets, entertainment hubs, and educational institutions, making daily life convenient for residents. Moreover, the tranquil environment of the community ensures a perfect blend of urban convenience and natural beauty.

World-Class Amenities at Amazonia

One of the standout features of DAMAC Properties Amazonia is its extensive range of amenities, which cater to all age groups. Residents can indulge in various recreational activities, ensuring a fulfilling lifestyle within the community.

Key Amenities in Amazonia include:

  • Leisure & Entertainment: Amphitheatre, floating cinema, outdoor cinema, snack bar.
  • Sports & Fitness: Cricket pitch, football pitch, volleyball court, outdoor gymnasium, jogging track, cycle paths.
  • Nature & Relaxation: Butterfly garden, petting farm, green zone, picnic park, zen garden.
  • Water Activities: Boating lake, fishing lake, lazy river, man-made beach, splash pad, water playground, water slide.
  • Family & Kids’ Fun: Play areas, snakes & ladders game, giant chess game, maze, paintball arcade.
  • Social Spaces: Barbecue areas, picnic park.With such a diverse range of amenities, Amazonia ensures that residents enjoy a holistic lifestyle within the community without having to step outside for entertainment or fitness facilities.

Investment Opportunities in Amazonia by DAMAC Properties

For investors, investment opportunities in Amazonia by DAMAC Properties are highly lucrative. The demand for residential units in well-established communities like DAMAC Hills 2 continues to rise, making Amazonia a high-potential investment. Here’s why investing in Amazonia is a smart decision:

  • Growing Rental Demand – With Dubai’s growing expatriate population, rental demand in well-developed communities is constantly increasing.
  • Freehold Ownership – Expats can own property in Amazonia, making it an attractive choice for international buyers.
  • Luxury Living at Competitive Prices – Compared to other premium communities in Dubai, Amazonia offers a luxurious lifestyle at competitive prices.
  • Developer Reputation – As a project by DAMAC Properties, one of Dubai’s leading real estate developers, Amazonia is backed by quality construction and timely project delivery.
